nonCookieState.name: l99-event-and-provenance-state
nonCookieState.mechanism: append-only files and explicit runtime stores
nonCookieState.purpose: Keep tenant, provenance, event, promotion, and recovery state out of browser cookies.

prohibited: tenant, user, authorization, provenance, revocation, or canon state in cookies
dashboard authentication claims without a server identity layer
cookie state becoming a second event bus or source of operational truth
